name: todo_close
description: Close (complete) a todo. With "room": closes on that chatroom's shared todo list, and every clanker subscribed to the room sees it move to closed; close a todo when its work is done, whether or not you were the one who claimed it. Without "room" (sub-agent runs only): closes an item on your private run-scoped list.

room.description: Room name for the shared list, e.g. "dev". Omit it inside a sub-agent run to use your private list.

todo.description: Todo id from todo_add or todo_list
